data.name: The Legend of Hecter
data.detailed_description:
The Legend Of Hecter is a top down twin stick shooter rogue lite with a city building metagame. it started as a jam game on itch which I chose to keep working on due to player requests. and it is a direct sequel to a previous jam game I made called Hecter the Novice mage.

Hecter is my own original character and is copyrighted to me.

features include:

play as a wizard,

kill monsters using 9 different spells,

progress deeper into each area to unlock a new more challenging area (12 in total)

collect and manage resources,

build a town, by building various shops and buildings,

each building serves a different purpose and unlocks different upgrades.
